v. 懷恨；怨恨
example: He still holds a grudge against the manager who dismissed him unfairly. (他仍對當年不公平解僱他的經理懷有積怨。)

meaning:
n. 外殼；船體
v. 去殼；剝殼
example: Farmers hull the rice after harvest to remove the dry outer layer. (農民在收成後把稻穀去殼，除去乾燥的外層。)

meaning: vt. 徹底搜尋；刷洗
example: Detectives scoured the whole area for clues before the trail went cold. (偵探在線索中斷前仔細搜查了這個地區。)

meaning: vt. 使喪失；使喪親
example: The fire bereaved the family of everything they owned in a single night. (那場火災在一夜之間使這個家庭失去所有財物。)

meaning: vt. 熄滅；撲滅
example: She quickly extinguished the small kitchen fire with a damp towel before it could spread to the curtains. (她迅速用濕毛巾撲滅廚房的小火，以免火勢蔓延到窗簾。)

meaning: v. 責罵；斥責
example: His mother scolded him for arriving home so late without calling or sending a message. (他媽媽責罵他這麼晚回家，卻沒先打電話或傳訊息。)

meaning: v. 刺繡；繡花
example: The dress was embroidered with silver thread along the neckline and sleeves. (這件洋裝的領口和袖子都用銀線刺繡。)

meaning: adj. 氣候的；氣候條件的
example: Climatic conditions here make it difficult to grow wheat without artificial irrigation. (這裡的氣候條件使得沒有人工灌溉就很難種小麥。)

meaning:
n. 責備；譴責
v. 責備；斥責
example: He looked at her with quiet, angry reproach, though he said nothing at all. (他帶著壓抑而憤怒的責備眼神看著她，卻一句話也沒說。)

meaning: n. 大學校長；總理
example: The chancellor spoke briefly at the ceremony, praising students for their patience during the long difficult building work. (大學校長在典禮上簡短致詞，讚揚學生在漫長艱難的施工期間展現耐心。)

meaning: v. 滲入；潛入
example: Rainwater has begun to infiltrate the cracks in the old concrete wall. (雨水已開始滲入舊混凝土牆的裂縫。)

meaning:
adj. 平靜的；和平的
n. 太平洋
example: The sea was unusually pacific that morning, so the fishermen set out early. (那天早上海面異常平靜，漁民因此提早出海。)

meaning: adj. 溫帶的；溫和的
example: The island has a temperate climate, with mild winters and warm but not hot summers. (這座島氣候溫和，冬天不冷，夏天溫暖但不炎熱。)

meaning: n. 鏟子；鐵鍬
example: He dug the hole with a spade and filled it with compost. (他用鏟子挖洞，再填進堆肥。)

meaning: adj. 花卉的；花朵的
example: She chose a light floral wallpaper to make the small bedroom feel brighter and more welcoming. (她挑了淺色花卉壁紙，讓小臥室看起來更明亮、更溫馨。)

meaning: adj. 逾期的；延誤的
example: The long overdue train was finally announced, but the platform had changed suddenly without any clear public explanation. (誤點很久的火車終於廣播了，但月台突然更改，卻沒有任何清楚的公開說明。)

meaning: n. 疏離；離間
example: Social media can deepen alienation among teenagers, especially when online comparisons replace genuine face-to-face conversation. (社群媒體可能加深青少年的疏離感，尤其是當線上比較取代了面對面真誠交談時。)

meaning: adj. 識字的；有文化的
example: Almost every adult in the village is literate and reads the local paper. (村裡幾乎每個成年人都識字，也會讀地方報。)

meaning:
n. 儲備；囤積
vt. 儲備；囤積
example: The family keeps a small stockpile of rice and tinned food, in case shops close during sudden storms. (這家人囤了一小批米和罐頭食品，以防商店在突發暴風雨期間關門。)

meaning:
n. 清潔劑；洗滌劑
adj. 清潔的；洗滌用的
example: A few drops of mild detergent will remove the grease from the kitchen floor. (幾滴溫和清潔劑就能去除廚房地板上的油汙。)

meaning:
n. 軟木塞；軟木
vt. 以軟木塞塞住
example: He pulled the cork out slowly so that the wine would not spill. (他慢慢拔出軟木塞，免得酒灑出來。)

meaning: n. 竹；竹子
example: Farmers plant bamboo along the riverbank to prevent the soil from washing away. (農民在河岸種竹子，以防止土壤被沖刷流失。)

meaning:
v. 閃爍；閃耀
n. 閃光；閃爍
example: The lights of the distant fishing village twinkled brightly across the dark water. (遠處漁村的燈火在漆黑的水面上明亮閃爍。)

meaning: adj. 粗俗的；庸俗的
example: The comedian's jokes were so vulgar that several families with children left early. (那位喜劇演員的笑話太粗俗，好幾個家庭提早離場。)

meaning: n. 高地；高原
example: Sheep and cattle graze freely on the highlands throughout the summer months. (牛羊整個夏季都在高地上吃草。)

meaning: adj. 多山的；山岳的
example: The rugged mountainous landscape attracts many walkers, yet local rescue teams are still called out almost every weekend. (崎嶇多山的地貌吸引許多健行者，但當地救援隊仍幾乎每個週末都被叫出動。)

meaning:
adj. 順時針的
adv. 順時針地；順時針方向
example: Turn the metal handle slowly clockwise until the water stops dripping completely. (慢慢順時針轉動金屬把手，直到水完全停止滴漏。)

meaning: n. 拆除；拆毀
example: The demolition of the old tower took weeks, and nearby residents bitterly complained about the thick, constant dust. (拆除那座舊塔花了好幾週，附近居民強烈抱怨濃厚且持續不散的灰塵。)

meaning: n. 閹牛；公牛
example: In many regions, an ox still pulls the plough in small fields. (在許多地區，小塊田地仍由公牛拉犁。)

meaning: vt. 積聚；累積
example: Over thirty years he amassed a remarkably large collection of old maps. (三十年間他積聚了一批數量可觀的舊地圖。)

meaning: n. 芳香；香氣
example: The fragrance of jasmine fills the street on warm evenings in spring. (春天溫暖的傍晚，茉莉的芳香瀰漫整條街。)

meaning: n. 矽；矽元素
example: Most solar panels are made from silicon, which converts sunlight into electricity. (大多數太陽能板由矽製成，能把陽光轉換成電力。)

meaning: n. 爬行動物；爬蟲類
example: The desert is home to several reptiles that are active only at night. (沙漠是多種爬行動物的棲地，牠們只在夜間活動。)

meaning: v. 摸索；暗中摸索
example: He had to grope along the corridor because the power had gone out. (因為停電，他只能沿著走廊摸索前進。)

meaning: v. 使興奮；使振奮
example: The steep descent can exhilarate even experienced cyclists as they race to the coast. (陡峭的下坡甚至能讓經驗豐富的自行車騎士感到興奮，他們一路衝向海岸。)

meaning: n. 樞紐；核心
example: Good customer service is the pivot on which the company's reputation depends. (顧客服務是這家公司聲譽所繫的核心。)

meaning: n. 燈籠；提燈
example: Hundreds of paper lanterns were hung along the street for the autumn festival. (為了秋日慶典，街道上掛了數百個紙燈籠。)

meaning: v. 駁斥；反駁
example: The scientist firmly refuted the claim with evidence from three large independent studies published recently. (這位科學家以近期發表的三項大型獨立研究證據，堅決駁斥那項說法。)

meaning: adj. 渾濁的；陰暗的
example: The pond looked murky after heavy rain washed soil into the water. (大雨把泥土沖進水裡後，池塘看起來很渾濁。)

meaning: n. 大風；強風
example: A fierce gale tore down power lines and left the village in darkness. (強烈大風吹斷電線，讓村莊陷入一片黑暗。)

meaning: vt. 滋養；養育
example: A diet of fish and vegetables nourishes the body better than fried snacks. (魚和蔬菜的飲食，比油炸零食更能滋養身體。)

meaning: n. 潤髮乳；護髮素
example: The hotel provides shampoo and conditioner, but guests frequently complain that the tiny travel bottles are too small. (飯店提供洗髮精和潤髮乳，但房客常抱怨小巧的旅行瓶裝分量太少。)

meaning: vt. 使幻滅；使醒悟
example: The poor service soon disillusioned the tourists who had read glowing reviews. (糟糕的服務很快讓那些讀過好評的遊客不再抱幻想。)

meaning: adj. 長草的；草地的
example: They spread an old blanket on the grassy bank, watching several ducks drift slowly across the quiet river. (他們在長草的河岸鋪開舊毯子，看著幾隻鴨子慢慢漂過安靜的河面。)

meaning:
n. 兩棲動物
adj. 兩棲的；水陸兩棲的
example: Amphibians are especially sensitive to pollution because they absorb water through their skin. (兩棲動物對汙染特別敏感，因為牠們透過皮膚吸收水分。)

meaning: n. 耗竭；枯竭
example: Overfishing has led to the rapid depletion of fish stocks in this region. (過度捕撈導致這個區域的魚群迅速枯竭。)

meaning: adj. 相當大的；可觀的
example: A sizeable crowd gathered in the square to hear the election results. (一大群人在廣場聚集，聆聽選舉結果。)

meaning: adj. 陸地的；地球的
example: Terrestrial animals often struggle when forests are cleared quickly for new roads. (森林被砍伐來開新路時，陸地動物往往難以生存。)

meaning:
n. 電報；電信
v. 發電報；打電報
example: Before the telephone, the telegraph was the fastest way to send urgent news. (在電話出現之前，電報是傳送緊急消息最快的方式。)

meaning:
adj. 草本的；藥草的
n. 草本植物；藥草
example: She drinks herbal tea every evening instead of coffee because it helps her sleep. (她每天晚上喝草本茶而不喝咖啡，因為那有助於入睡。)

meaning:
n. 間歇；平靜期
v. 使平靜；哄睡
example: During a brief lull in the storm, we ran to the car. (趁暴風雨短暫的間歇，我們跑向車子。)

meaning: v. 悶住；覆蓋
example: He smothered the chips in salt, ignoring his doctor's repeated warnings about high blood pressure. (他在薯條上撒了大量鹽，無視醫師多次提醒他注意高血壓。)

meaning: v. 瀰漫；滲透
example: The smell of fresh bread permeated the whole house on Sunday mornings. (星期天早上，新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫整間屋子。)

meaning: n. 小溪；溪流
example: A narrow brook runs through the village and supplies water to several gardens. (一條小溪流經村莊，為幾座花園供水。)

meaning: n. 同化；融入
example: Language classes can speed up the assimilation of newcomers into local communities. (語言課程可以加快新住民融入當地社區。)

meaning: adj. 遲緩的；遲鈍的
example: The computer became sluggish after several programs were left running all day. (好幾個程式開了一整天之後，電腦變得越來越慢。)

meaning: adj. 裝飾性的；觀賞用的
example: Ornamental trees line the broad avenue, yet they unfortunately produce no fruit and require expensive annual pruning. (寬闊的大道兩旁種著觀賞樹木，但它們不結果實，且每年修剪費用高昂。)

meaning: v. 創新；革新
example: Companies must innovate continuously in order to remain competitive in global markets. (企業必須持續創新，才能在國際市場保持競爭力。)

meaning: adj. 不穩定的；危險的
example: Many delivery riders work under precarious conditions with no paid sick leave. (許多外送員在沒有有薪病假的不穩定條件下工作。)

meaning: n. 消遣；嗜好
example: Fishing remains a popular pastime among people who live near the river. (釣魚仍是住在河邊的人們喜愛的消遣。)

meaning: n. 野兔；兔
example: A hare darted across the field and disappeared into the tall grass. (一隻野兔衝過田野，消失在高草叢中。)

meaning: adj. 膽怯的；羞怯的
example: Timid animals such as deer rarely approach areas where people frequently walk. (鹿等膽小的動物很少接近人們經常走動的地方。)

meaning: n. 詳述；闡述
example: The report offers a detailed elaboration of the plan, including costs and timelines. (這份報告詳盡闡述該計畫，包括成本與時程。)

meaning:
n. 麥芽；麥芽酒
v. 製麥芽；加麥芽
example: The brewery uses locally grown malt to produce several of its most popular beers. (這家釀酒廠用當地種植的麥芽，生產幾款最受歡迎的啤酒。)

meaning: n. 合金；融合物
example: The alloy is light but strong, which makes it suitable for bicycle frames. (這種合金輕又堅固，因此適合做腳踏車車架。)

meaning: vi. 分歧；偏離
example: The two studies diverge sharply on the likely impact of automation on employment. (這兩份研究對自動化可能造成的就業影響看法嚴重分歧。)

meaning: n. 鱷魚；鱷
example: Warning signs along the river remind visitors that crocodiles live in these waters. (河邊的警告標誌提醒遊客，這片水域有鱷魚棲息。)

meaning: adj. 淫穢的；猥褻的
example: The website was shut down for displaying obscene images without any age checks. (這個網站因未做年齡查核就展示淫穢圖片而被關閉。)

meaning:
adj. 偽造的；仿冒的
v. 偽造；仿冒
example: Customs officers seized thousands of counterfeit handbags at the port last week. (海關人員上週在港口查獲數千個假冒名牌包。)

meaning: vt. 使困惑；使迷惘
example: The riddle perplexed the children for hours, until a shy girl gave the correct answer. (這個謎語讓孩子們困惑了好幾個小時，直到一名害羞的女孩說出正確答案。)

meaning: n. 增額；增量
example: The annual increment is small but is paid to every member of staff. (每年定期加薪幅度不大，但每位員工都能領到。)

meaning: n. 男爵；巨頭
example: The local baron owned most of the farmland and charged high rents. (當地的男爵擁有大部分農地，並收取高額租金。)
